tool_input_args.value:
import json

# Parse the CSV data
lines = sales_data.replace('\r\n', '\n').strip().split('\n')
header = lines[0].split(',')
all_deals = []
for line in lines[1:]:
    if line.strip():
        fields = line.split(',')
        all_deals.append(dict(zip(header, fields)))

# Filter for James Okafor and Sofia Delgado
james_deals = [d for d in all_deals if d['rep_name'] == 'James Okafor']
sofia_deals = [d for d in all_deals if d['rep_name'] == 'Sofia Delgado']

# Print full table header
print(f"{'Deal ID':<10} {'Rep Name':<18} {'Region':<8} {'Product':<25} {'Amount':>10} {'Close Date':<12} {'Status':<8}")
print("-" * 95)

# Print James's deals
print("\n📊 JAMES OKAFOR — Q3 Deals:")
print("-" * 95)
j_total = 0
j_won = j_lost = j_pending = 0
j_won_amt = 0
for d in james_deals:
    amt = int(d['amount'])
    j_total += amt
    if d['status'] == 'won': j_won += 1; j_won_amt += amt
    elif d['status'] == 'lost': j_lost += 1
    else: j_pending += 1
    print(f"{d['deal_id']:<10} {d['rep_name']:<18} {d['region']:<8} {d['product']:<25} ${amt:>9,} {d['close_date']:<12} {d['status']:<8}")

print(f"\n  → Total deals: {len(james_deals)}  |  Won: {j_won}  |  Lost: {j_lost}  |  Pending: {j_pending}")
print(f"  → Total pipeline: ${j_total:,}  |  Won revenue: ${j_won_amt:,}")

# Print Sofia's deals
print("\n\n📊 SOFIA DELGADO — Q3 Deals:")
print("-" * 95)
s_total = 0
s_won = s_lost = s_pending = 0
s_won_amt = 0
for d in sofia_deals:
    amt = int(d['amount'])
    s_total += amt
    if d['status'] == 'won': s_won += 1; s_won_amt += amt
    elif d['status'] == 'lost': s_lost += 1
    else: s_pending += 1
    print(f"{d['deal_id']:<10} {d['rep_name']:<18} {d['region']:<8} {d['product']:<25} ${amt:>9,} {d['close_date']:<12} {d['status']:<8}")

print(f"\n  → Total deals: {len(sofia_deals)}  |  Won: {s_won}  |  Lost: {s_lost}  |  Pending: {s_pending}")
print(f"  → Total pipeline: ${s_total:,}  |  Won revenue: ${s_won_amt:,}")

# Comparison
print("\n\n📈 HEAD-TO-HEAD COMPARISON:")
print("-" * 50)
print(f"  {'Metric':<25} {'James Okafor':>12} {'Sofia Delgado':>14}")
print(f"  {'Total Deals':<25} {len(james_deals):>12} {len(sofia_deals):>14}")
print(f"  {'Won':<25} {j_won:>12} {s_won:>14}")
print(f"  {'Lost':<25} {j_lost:>12} {s_lost:>14}")
print(f"  {'Pending':<25} {j_pending:>12} {s_pending:>14}")
print(f"  {'Total Pipeline':<25} {'${:,}'.format(j_total):>12} {'${:,}'.format(s_total):>14}")
print(f"  {'Won Revenue':<25} {'${:,}'.format(j_won_amt):>12} {'${:,}'.format(s_won_amt):>14}")
print(f"  {'Win Rate':<25} {j_won/len(james_deals)*100:>11.0f}% {s_won/len(sofia_deals)*100:>13.0f}%")
